Refund policy
 We hope you'll be completely happy with your purchase, but we'll gladly accept exchanges or returns on all items (except those marked "Final Sale") for store credit only within 14 DAYS from the time of delivery.  
 We provide free return shipping for all domestic orders. International customers are responsible for return shipping.
 Goods must be received unworn and in original condition with tags attached. We encourage you to inspect your order as soon as your package arrives to ensure everything is in good condition.
 We reserve the right to refuse returns on items that have been worn, soiled, laundered or altered in any way.
 We will not accept items marked FINAL SALE .
 We cannot refund original shipping charges.

Blacksmith.text:
Refund policy
 Returns 
Our policy lasts 14 days. If 14 days have gone by since receiving your purchase, unfortunately we can’t offer you a refund or exchange. 
To be eligible for a return, your item must be unused and in the same condition that you received it. It must also be in the original packaging. 
To complete your return, we require a receipt or proof of purchase. 
Please do not send your purchase back to the manufacturer. 
 Refunds (if applicable) 
Once your return is received and inspected, we will send you an email to notify you that we have received your returned item. We will also notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund. 
If you are approved, then your refund will be processed, and a credit will automatically be applied to your credit card or original method of payment, within a certain amount of days. 
 Late or missing refunds (if applicable) 
If you haven’t received a refund yet, first check your bank account again. 
Then contact your credit card company, it may take some time before your refund is officially posted. 
Next contact your bank. There is often some processing time before a refund is posted. 
If you’ve done all of this and you still have not received your refund yet, please contact us at orders@blacksmith-store.com.
If the item wasn’t marked as a gift when purchased, or the gift giver had the order shipped to themselves to give to you later, we will send a refund to the gift giver and he will find out about your return. 
 Shipping 
To return your product, head over to our Returns Portal 
You will be responsible for paying for your own shipping costs for returning your item. Shipping costs are non-refundable. If you receive a refund, the cost of return shipping will be deducted from your refund. 
Depending on where you live, the time it may take for your exchanged product to reach you, may vary.
 We suggest using a trackable shipping service or purchasing shipping insurance. We don’t guarantee that we will receive your returned item.
 Blacksmith Store, The Woodyard, High Street, Naseby, Northamptonshire NN6 6DD

Blue Owl Workshop.text:
Refund policy
 Blue Owl accepts returns for store credit only. 
 Returns must arrive back to Blue Owl within 21 days of when the items were shipped to the recipient. To return an item, you must contact Blue Owl within 5 days of receiving the shipment for return authorization.
 Items returned to Blue Owl must have their original tags and must be free of wear, wash, damage, odor, or any other condition that would prevent them from being sold as new.
 Items sold at discount are final sale and are not subject to return. Items ordered by special request, such as pre-orders or items not regularly carried by Blue Owl are not subject to return.
 Underwear, socks, swimwear, and any type of undergarment are final sale and are not subject to return. Denim that has been hemmed, soaked, or altered in any way, even if done through Blue Owl, are not subject to return. Boots and shoes shipped outside of the USA are final sale and are not subject to return.
 RETURN PROCESS:
 Request return authorization on our   returns page .
 Ship Authorized Returns: Returns must be shipped no later than seven days of our return authorization, and must be received within 21 days of the initial order. You are responsible for all return shipping costs as well as any items lost or damaged. We recommend that you insure your package and use a service that allows you to track your package. Blue Owl will not accept a return shipped COD.
 Receive Credit/Exchange: Upon arriving at Blue Owl all items will be inspected for any signs of wear, wash, damage, odor, or any other condition that would prevent them from being sold as new. If the items are acceptable you will be contacted via email with information on the credit or exchange. Unacceptable items, including items shipped without authorization, will be returned to sender at sender's cost.
 Return Shipping Address:
Blue Owl Workshop
C/O Returns
124 NW Canal Street Ste. 1
Seattle, WA 98107

Refund policy
 Bronson offers a 30-day returning period. Please contact customer service within 30 days of receiving your full order. The full process takes about 7 business days. Be sure to send your return within 30 days of the delivery date—returns after this period won’t be accepted.
 We provide a return label for your order with service charge starting from $7. Please dispatch the parcel as soon as possible after receiving the shipping label from our customer service team.
 Prices are as follows: 
 Numbers of Items 
 Charge 
 1-2 
 $7 
 3-5 
 $11 
 6+ 
 $14 
 Returns for refunds in our store credit cards or exchanges will be free of charge. 
 The return label is available for the following countries and areas: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, France, Germany and Australia. 
 *For countries and areas not listed, please send your order to our US, UK, or China warehouse(free of service charge). For specific addresses and shipping options, please contact cs@bronsonshop.com .
 After   the returned order is delivered, our customer service team will process the refund or exchange for you within 5-7 business days. 
 Refunds are issued back to the original form of payment. Please note that the processing time may vary depending on PayPal or your bank. 
 Payment Method 
 Time Frame 
 PayPal 
 1-3 Business Days

 How do I make a return? 
 Log in to your account .
 Find the order you want to return.
 Fill in the information for your order, select the item(s) you would like to return, please leave a note if you want to exchange item(s).
 You will receive a notification when you submit.
 Click the button to print the shipping label.  Drop the parcel off at your nearest post office according to the return label. Please keep the receipt and send it to cs@bronsonshop.com . 
 Once the parcel arrives, please wait for the shipping information of the exchange or refund notification.
 Order Cancellation
 We accept order cancellation before the parcel is shipped. If the order is cancelled you will get full refund. We can not cancel the order if the parcel is already shipped out.
 Important Notice: 
 Returns are accepted only for items that are new, unwashed, undamaged, and still have packaging.
Items showing visible signs of wear, alterations, or missing/damaged packaging (excluding special paper wrapping) are not eligible for return. Thank you for your understanding.
 You must use the return label we provide, then send the return package to us within 30 days after the delivery date. Additionally, we are not responsible for the loss of the package if it returned without permission.
 We can only process one time exchange/refund for items in your order.
 Undergarments(Socks, Boxer Shorts, and Tank Tops), free gifts, 'Assure+ Service' products, products tagged 'Non-returnable', 'final sale' products, and any other items for which return or exchange is noted as not being supported on the product page, cannot be returned or exchanged unless faulty. 
 Unauthorized returns will not be processed.
 Damaged, defective, or incorrect items must be reported within 14 days of delivery.
 We are not liable for any return packages that may become lost or stolen in transit. Please keep your proof of postage and/or return tracking number when shipping back your returns.
 Please kindly provide us with what express you choose and the return tracking number once available. You may send them to cs@bronsonshop.com .
 Please do not send your return to the sender's address on your package. This is not the return address and the processing of your return will not be successful. You can only return to the address we provide.
 Please ensure you don't put non-Bronson items in your return package by accident. We will not be responsible for sending back those items to you.
 We reserve the right to solely define and limit, refuse, and/or reject returns from customers at any time due to:
 An irregular or excessive returns history indicative of "wardrobing";
 An irregular or excessive returns history involving worn, altered, laundered, damaged, or missing items;
 Potential fraudulent or criminal activity;
 Similarly, we reserve the right to refuse service to any customer or entity, due to similar actions as noted above. 
 Important Notes: Any Taxes & Duties collected will not be refunded in the event of a return
 START RETURN

Brut Clothing.text:
Refund policy
 RETURN POLICY
 WHAT ARE THE RETURN CONDITIONS ? 
 You have 14 days from receipt of your order to change your mind and return it to us for a refund, exchange or credit card.
 Return shipping costs are at the buyer's expense.
 To ensure that your return is accepted, here are some key point to keep in mind :
 - Your item must be returned undamaged, unwashed, in its original packaging, with no signs of use, with label
 - Make sure your clothes are clean
 All non-conforming returns will be refused.
 WHAT IS THE RETURN PROCEDURE ? 
 Visit the return portal by clicking the following link: https://brutclothingusa.returnscenter.com/  
 - Fill in the required information (postal code and order number)
 - Indicate the item you wish to return and the reason for return in order to generate a return authorization
 - Once you've paid the return shipping costs, you'll receive the return label
 - Print the slip and stick it on the parcel/box
 - Drop off the parcel
 HOW MUCH DOES IT COST TO RETURN AN ORDER ? 
 The amount varies from one region to another.
 WHEN AND HOW WILL I RECEIVE MY REFUND ? 
 Once your return package has been received, your return will be processed as quickly as possible. You will receive an automatic e-mail to let you know when your refund has been processed. 
 Please allow approximately 5 working days from receipt of your return for our service to process your refund. 
 It may then take up to 48 hours for the refund to appear on your account. 
 HOW DO I GET MY MONEY BACK ? 
 Your refund is automatically credited back to the same payment method you used to place your order.

 Refund policy
 We have a 30-day return policy, which means you have 30 days after receiving your item to request a return. 
To be eligible for a return, your item must be in the same condition that you received it, unworn or unused, with tags, and in its original packaging. You’ll also need the receipt or proof of purchase. 
To start a return, you can contact us at support@worldrugbyshop.com. If your return is accepted, we’ll send you a return shipping label, as well as instructions on how and where to send your package. Items sent back to us without first requesting a return will not be accepted. 
You can always contact us for any return question at support@worldrugbyshop.com.
 Damages and issues 
Please inspect your order upon reception and contact us immediately if the item is defective, damaged or if you receive the wrong item, so that we can evaluate the issue and make it right.
 Exceptions / non-returnable items 
Certain types of items cannot be returned, like perishable goods (such as food, flowers, or plants), custom products (such as special orders or personalized items), and personal care goods (such as beauty products). We also do not accept returns for hazardous materials, flammable liquids, or gases. Please get in touch if you have questions or concerns about your specific item. 
Unfortunately, we cannot accept returns on sale items or gift cards.
 Exchanges 
The fastest way to ensure you get what you want is to return the item you have, and once the return is accepted, make a separate purchase for the new item.
 Refunds 
We will notify you once we’ve received and inspected your return, and let you know if the refund was approved or not. If approved, you’ll be automatically refunded on your original payment method. Please remember it can take some time for your bank or credit card company to process and post the refund too.
